recommendation_summary: Act now: make the lead and the two qualified engineers reviewers on every change in the existing tracker, require approval from any one of the three, and enforce this as a tracker/repo review policy. Keep the four-person team as is, with no new tools or cost. Optional additions: none. Verification: watch the 'coding done' to 'approved' wait on the next few changes. Unmet needs: none stated beyond confirming the fix works.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You need changes to stop waiting when the lead is absent. Nothing in the evidence calls for new tooling, a squad structure, or planning workshops.
labels.Deleted: Spotify squads and chapters, Jira Align, quarterly planning workshops, new tooling spend.
labels.Bottleneck: Review approval. The last six changes each took under a day to code, then waited three days because the lead was the sole reviewer and was away.
labels.Checked myself: Nothing directly. This rests on what you told me: the six changes' timings, the lead's absence, and that two other engineers are qualified and authorized to approve.

note: The reply picks a bounded reviewer-coverage rule, explicitly drops the whole framed stack, and admits it has no independent verification.
